topics.description: The shooting of Alex Pretti during a protest in Minneapolis is trending due to concerns over police accountability and the Trump administration's response to the incident.
topics.reason: The shooting and subsequent investigation have sparked national attention and criticism of the Trump administration's handling of the situation.

topics.description: The federal funding freeze for various projects, including the Gateway Tunnel, is trending due to concerns over the impact on infrastructure development and economic growth.
topics.reason: The funding freeze has raised concerns among lawmakers and industry experts about the feasibility of completing critical infrastructure projects.
